name: 小怂猫
evolution: 小怂猫 → 怒目怂猫 Lv.36
description: 胆量极小的精灵，曾因极少被观测记录，被王国记录为已灭绝的物种。翼膜上的眼状图案可以吓退大多数天敌，遇到敌人会张开双臂一动不动地站着，一直到对方离开或者自己昏厥。
descriptionEn: An extremely timid spirit. Because it was so rarely observed or recorded, the kingdom once listed it as an extinct species. The eye-shaped patterns on its wing membranes can scare off most natural predators; when it meets an enemy it spreads its arms and stands perfectly still until the other side leaves or it faints.

skills.name: 防御
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage taken by 70%; counters attacks.

skills.name: 气波
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 化劲
skills.descriptionEn: Self gains +40 power to all skills.

skills.name: 一拳
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 提气
skills.description: 自己获得全技能威力+40，若敌方本回合更换精灵，额外获得威力+50。
skills.descriptionEn: Self gains +40 power to all skills; if the enemy switches spirits this turn, gains an additional +50 power.

skills.name: 叠势
skills.description: 造成魔伤，2连击，每成功应对1次，本技能连击数永久+2。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; 2 hits; for each successful counter, this skill's hit count permanently +2.

skills.name: 摇篮曲
skills.description: 敌方获得全技能能耗+3，应对防御：额外造成打断，且敌方下回合获得眩晕。
skills.descriptionEn: The enemy gains +3 energy cost to all skills; when countering a defense skill: additionally causes an interrupt, and the enemy is stunned next turn.

skills.name: 无影脚
skills.description: 造成物伤，应对状态：本次技能威力变为2倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; when countering a status skill: this use's skill power becomes 2x.

skills.name: 截拳
skills.description: 造成物伤，应对状态：额外造成打断，回复该技能能耗的能量。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; when countering a status skill: additionally causes an interrupt and recovers energy equal to that skill's energy cost.

skills.name: 重击
skills.description: 造成物伤，每次使用后，本技能能耗永久+1。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; after each use, this skill's energy cost permanently +1.

skills.name: 技巧打击
skills.description: 造成物伤，应对状态：本次技能威力变为10倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; when countering a status skill: this use's skill power becomes 10x.
